description: This file defines the class WorkerPoolImplementation, which implements a worker thread pool with an inner Dispatcher class, inheriting from WPEFramework core classes. It manages thread pool creation, dispatching tasks, and lifecycle for worker threads.

classes.name: WorkerPoolImplementation
classes.description: A class that extends a worker pool and thread pool callback to manage a set of worker threads and task dispatching.

inner_classes.name: Dispatcher
inner_classes.description: An inner class implementing the dispatcher interface, responsible for dispatching jobs to worker threads.

methods.name: WorkerPoolImplementation
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the worker pool with specified thread count and stack size.

methods.name: ~WorkerPoolImplementation
methods.description: Destructor that stops the worker pool.
